topics.title: Sand.ai launches full MAGI-2 audio-video generation model
topics.summary: Sand.ai says its full MAGI-2 model has 480 billion total parameters and generates up to 30 seconds of 1080p video with native audio. The company says open-source releases and a detailed technical report will follow.

topics.title: UK FCA sets expectations for agentic AI in financial services
topics.summary: The FCA says existing rules apply when financial firms use AI agents and that providers may need authorisation depending on what their products do. Its guidance asks firms to consider permissions, liability and customer support when customers use agents to interact with them.

topics.title: OpenAI reports laboratory binding results for GPT-6.2 protein designs
topics.summary: OpenAI and partner Onava tested proteins based on designs from a prerelease GPT-6.2 model. OpenAI reports binding evidence for 35 of 322 candidates across five targets; specialized models supplied sequences and helped select candidates for laboratory tests.
